name: Dunnet Bay Club Campsite
suitableFor: Tourers, motorhomes and some tent campers; non-members welcome
dogs: Ideal for dogs, with a dog walk from the site
beachAccess: Overlooks the sands of Dunnet Bay with beach walks from the site
confirmedFeatures: Toilet block, electric hook-up, laundry, motorhome service point, Wi-Fi, accessible shower room
overview: The Caravan and Motorhome Club site at Dunnet Bay looks out over the long sandy beach, with walks straight from the pitches. It has 54 touring pitches and two tent pitches, and non-members are welcome. Facilities include a toilet block, laundry and a motorhome service point, and it is open from spring to early November.
surfTripFit: It is the closest place to the surf at Dunnet, so you can check the bay from your pitch.
